cases.prompt: Review where UI state lives in this app and flag over-globalization.

assertions: Classifies each reviewed state item by placement and lifetime with consumer evidence.

cases.prompt: Classify our state as local/shared/URL/server-cache/persistent and find misplacements.

assertions: Identifies derived-state drift and hydration/SSR mismatch risks.
Assesses persistence risks including sensitive data.

cases.prompt: Our state is duplicated across stores - review the boundaries with evidence.

assertions: Records the not-inspected list and evidence needed.
Does not claim an edit or runtime verification.

cases.prompt: Design the feature-flag system: flag store, one internal interface, evaluation placement and kill-switch flip authority.

assertions: Routes to `feature-flag-architect`; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: A store persists permission-derived UI flags while the URL carries a different filter state, and SSR renders both. Review the conflict and evidence.

assertions: Classifies both states and identifies the stale-permission persistence risk with evidence.
Names the hydration mismatch source and the URL/store duplication.
Records what cannot be inspected and a minimal recommendation.

cases.prompt: Just move everything to one big store and delete the contexts - do the refactor as part of the review.

assertions: Refuses to refactor and stays review-only, returning the state map and ranked findings.
Explains the misplaced-placement risks rather than applying a change.
Does not claim an edit, test or runtime verification it did not perform.
